intuition: An explicit stack stores the path to the next smallest node, just as a recursive inorder traversal stores its call stack.

brute_force.approach: Store every node value from an inorder traversal, then return values by index.

optimal.approach: Keep only the current left spine; after returning a node, push the left spine of its right subtree.
optimal.time: O(1) amortized next, O(h) worst case

edge_cases: An empty tree has no next value.
The smallest value is available immediately after initialization.
The stack must be extended after returning a node with a right subtree.
